messages:
Kira Walsh: Heads-up  HelixAnalytics wants to run a POC with their tuned `eos-12b-fin` variant. Theyre using private S3 weights + a small LoRA. Main asks: can we serve it, recommend quant for latency (p95 <130ms), and provide a Dedicated ballpark? They also asked about audit logs and KMS.
Tom Becker: Ask for exact artifact layout (weights path, tokenizer.json). S3 vs HF changes onboarding flow. Any patched tokenizers?
Kira Walsh: They said S3 with manifest and tokenizer.json included. Will share link after DPA.
Rana Ahmed: Runtime quick take: eos-12b generally OK with nf4 on H100. For p95 <130ms on short dialogs (~80 tokens) recommend H100 preference + nf4. A100 requires fallback to 8-bit in many cases. Need to validate tokenizer and check for compiled extensions.
Rana Ahmed: Quick recommended smoke config:
variant: eos-12b-fin-nf4
quant: nf4
hw: h100
max_batch: 6
max_seq: 512
fallback: eos-12b-fin-8bit
Luis Ortega: Pricing ballpark: hosted private pilot (on-demand H100) ~ $7.5k/mo. Dedicated reserved (2x H100) for stable p95 <130ms ~ $24k/mo. Add ~12% for HA/burst, +20% if A100-only required.
Kira Walsh: Compliance: they require DPA + customer-managed KMS, plus audit logs for requests. Is Private deployment required for this data class?
compliance-bot: For audit/KMS: recommend Dedicated with customer-managed KMS or Private deployment depending on legal. SOC2 report and DPA required before artifact access.
Tom Becker: SE checklist for onboarding:
1) tokenizer sanity: python tools/tokenizer_check.py --s3-url s3://helix/eos-12b-fin/tokenizer.json
2) download + verify: python tools/verify_weights.py --s3-manifest s3://helix/eos-12b-fin/manifest.json
3) convert to nf4 (smoke): python tools/convert_to_nf4.py --in /tmp/weights.pt --out /tmp/weights_nf4.pt
Note: if `*.so` or fused kernels are present escalate to infra.
Rana Ahmed: Also run a short eval (10-15 prompts) from our financial-regress set to compare nf4 vs 8-bit quality before recommending nf4 in prod. Small fine-tunes can regress under quant.
Luis Ortega: I'll prep a pricing note and pilot vs reserved options for the buyer.
infra-bot: ticket INF-9999 created: "HelixAnalytics eos-12b-fin onboarding + nf4 smoke" assigned to Tom, Rana, Luis.
Kira Walsh: Action items: (1) I'll request S3 link + expected QPS and sample prompts (2) Tom to run tokenizer + verify weights by EOD+1 (3) Rana to run nf4 convert & smoke latency on H100 by EOD+2 (4) Luis to draft pricing + compliance note. Please drop ETAs in thread. :pray:
